a.xlink:title: Parses an entity number token of the form "#n".

Removes an entity from the state (pdi for players, edi for eggs).
Replaces a player's carried inventory from a pin message.
Updates a player's level from a plv message.
Applies the server's "pipi" full snapshot (position, orientation, level, inventory).
Creates a Trantorian from a pnw message.
Moves one resource unit between a player's inventory and its ground tile.
Applies a global/server message to the state.
Applies an egg message to the state.
Applies a common entity message to the state.
Applies a Trantorian message to the state.
Handles a pdr message: the player drops one resource onto its tile.
Handles a pgt message: the player picks one resource up from its tile.
